description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores of various models across six datasets, comparing their performance in anomaly detection tasks. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, labeled as SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "F1 Score (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, marked at intervals of 10. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group representing a dataset and containing four bars corresponding to different models: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). The bars within each group are arranged in the same order, as indicated by the legend. The F1 scores for the models vary across datasets, with the highest scores observed in the PSM dataset, where all models achieve scores above 90%, and the lowest scores in the WADI dataset, where all models score below 70%. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no visual emphasis is applied to any particular bar.
